triage_summary: from_dict silently truncates float IDs to int without warning at src/flywheel/todo.py:70. int(data['id']) accepts float and truncates it.
root_cause: int(data['id']) accepts float values and silently truncates them (e.g., int(1.5) becomes 1). No type check before conversion.
fix_approach: Add explicit float type check before int() conversion, raising clear ValueError with message indicating float is not acceptable.
risks: None - change only adds stricter validation that rejects previously silently-truncated values
